description: Read the page context capture a user made with the Visdenda browser extension, by capture id (the ctx_ id from Copy for your agent / Share capture). Returns the rendered page signals (title, canonical, robots, headings, JSON-LD, images, hreflang, robots.txt/llms.txt), the raw-vs-rendered field comparison that shows what non-JS crawlers see, and the user's note. Captures expire after 24 hours and are readable only by the account that uploaded them. Read-only. For the stored site audit findings and recent fixes on the same page use get_page_report.

captureId.description: ctx_ id from the browser extension

name: get_page_context
title: Read a page context capture
